about: Heat-relevant outcomes from COP31 since check-in 2 (check-in 3 of 4, 18 November 2026), found through search and tied to primary pages: UNEP and the Cool Coalition for the third Cooling Pledge Ministerial (16 November), WHO for its El Niño health response. The Antalya-to-Addis declaration is described as proposed, so it is not claimed as adopted. A claim passes only when one route holds all its terms. UNEP's own pages block automated checks, so the UNEP release as republished by Mirage News and the ministerial's agenda are second routes; a claim carried only by the republished copy is marked secondary.

claims.text: At the third Cooling Pledge Ministerial in Antalya on 16 November, co-chaired by Singapore and UNEP, governments backed a country-led, voluntary roadmap on heat resilience and sustainable cooling.

claims.where: Signal: third Cooling Pledge Ministerial (next step)
claims.text: The roadmap is to be launched at COP32 in Addis Ababa.

claims.where: Signal: third Cooling Pledge Ministerial (funding, announced)
claims.text: More than US$20 million in new support was announced for the Cool Coalition's work on the Global Cooling Pledge.

claims.where: Signal: WHO El Niño health response
claims.text: WHO is responding to El Niño's health risks at Grade 3, its highest emergency grade, under a plan for October 2026 to September 2027.

claims.where: Signal: WHO El Niño health response (heat)
claims.text: WHO names heat among the El Niño health risks it is preparing for.
